name: Storm Chaser

specialAbility.name: Tornado
specialAbility.description: Storm Chaser whips up a wild tornado that spins the enemy truck around and stuns it for a turn!

lore: Storm Chaser drives straight into the biggest, baddest storms and comes out the other side even stronger! Built with steel-blue armor and crackling lightning bolts, this truck carries the power of a thunderstorm under its hood. When it spins up a Tornado attack, everything goes flying!
